scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm migrate sh -c "npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test && npm run test:down
scripts.test:watch: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test npx jest --watch --coverage=false
